headline: A woman begged a man not to press charges and make her a felon after she blew up his car a
body: A woman begged a man not to press charges and make her a felon after she blew up his car and told him he was lucky he wasn’t home that day because she had been rejected. The man said, “You’re going to jail. ” She replied, “I can buy you a new car, please. ”.
